name: dsh-dialog-fence
description: A dialogue fence with one rule per .txt file: a shared rule layer that applies to every conversation plus an optional per-session layer, injected into the runtime-context snapshot (cache-safe, append-only, compression-durable). Installs as a normal DSH bundle, so it shows up under Plugins → Installed and can be installed/removed with the official installer; its rules are edited directly on the Settings page and inside its own bundle page.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/route.mjs && node test/client.mjs && node test/render.mjs
